node.database.sqlite.name: SQLite query or write
node.database.sqlite.description: Execute parameterized SQL against a selected business database file in one transaction. This is independent of internal state storage.
node.database.postgresql.name: PostgreSQL query or write
node.database.postgresql.description: Resolve a connection string from a secret and execute parameterized SQL on the selected peer. A missing commit response remains unknown.
node.database.redis.name: Redis key operation
node.database.redis.description: Get, set, delete or test one key over the selected interface. No command is automatically replayed after an unconfirmed response.
setting.ttlMs: SET expiry in milliseconds (0: no expiry)
